snippet.title: I Am A Stick – Official Trailer (2025) | Rage Platformer with Physics 🪵
snippet.description:
Yes... you’re a stick.

But not just any stick. You’re on an absurd journey to climb, roll, bounce, and rage your way home in this unforgiving physics-based platformer.

I Am A Stick is coming to PC on September 30, 2025!

🛒 Add it to your wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3882860/I_Am_A_Stick

🔔 Follow for more dev updates:

Twitter: https://x.com/CyclopsGamesDev

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/cyclops.games/
